description: Experience immersive audio with the Ultrapods Pro TWS Earbuds, featuring a sleek transparent design and vibrant multicolor accents. Equipped with 13mm HD bass drivers and Bold Bass technology, these earbuds deliver powerful sound quality. With Bluetooth 5.3 and Environmental Noise Cancellation (ENC), enjoy seamless connectivity and clear calls. The LED display on the charging case keeps you informed of battery levels, while the IPX7 rating ensures resistance to sweat and water. Enjoy up to 30 hours of playtime with fast charging capabilities.​
